parts.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Identity-preserving image-based 360 garment photography.
Reference image 1 is the exact garment: MiloShopHand ML Field Four Jacket, olive cotton-canvas #677054, tan edge piping #d9c9a8 on the stand collar and four flap pockets, brass center zipper, brass snaps, shoulder epaulettes, relaxed fit, long hanging sleeves and cuff tabs. Preserve the same cotton weave, cloth drape, seam construction, sleeve pose, pocket positions, proportions and color. Small interwoven ML chest monogram above the image-right chest pocket, unobscured by a pocket flap. Reference image 2 supplies ONLY the back artwork: floral M and exact MiloShopHand wordmark in contrasting light cream ink; ignore the burgundy background.
Create ONE precise 3-column x 2-row sprite atlas with EXACTLY SIX photographic views of THIS SAME jacket. Uniform ivory studio backdrop, identical lighting, same scale, same bottom hem baseline and center in every equal-sized cell. Garment fully visible with generous 8% margins, no clipping. Output a high-resolution portrait-cell contact sheet, target 1536x1280 or larger, at least 450 pixels per cell width. No grid lines, borders, gutters, labels, angle numbers, watermark, props, hanger, mannequin, person or text outside garment.
The ONLY change between cells is rotation of the garment around its perfectly vertical Y/Oy axis. Fixed level camera at garment center, no pitch, roll, camera elevation changes, perspective warp or garment deformation. Keep the photographic fabric detail of reference 1, NOT a smooth plastic, flat, low-poly or procedural 3D render.
Six sequential angles in row-major order: top-left 0 degrees FRONT; top-middle 15 degrees; top-right 30 degrees; bottom-left 45 degrees; bottom-middle 60 degrees; bottom-right 75 degrees toward the first side. These must be genuinely distinct 15-degree steps, never three repeated fronts. This is part A of a 24-frame turntable. 90 degrees in the next part will be the first true side silhouette; 180 will be BACK. Preserve everything except viewing angle. Do not add another jacket design, hood, extra pockets, straps or graphics.
parts.qa: Six distinct continuous front-to-side views. Same olive cotton-canvas jacket, four tan-edged flap pockets, upright; no clipped hem/sleeves. Angles approximate AI interpretations, not calibrated photographic measurements.
